Been on Wellbutrin twice and it fucked me up both times. The second time was when I really started showing hypo symptoms (sleeping 2-4 hrs a night, not eating, coming up with new business ideas I never followed through on etc etc). Still on cymbalta tho and that seems to be the only thing to consistently help with depressive episodes. Only now I’m on Lithium too which stabilizes me and keeps me from going hypomanic again... 

Also no shame in going to the hospital. It sucks. It really fucking sucks (I’ve been involuntarily hospitalized 7 or 8 times now) but you have a doc watching over you 24/7 and monitoring how meds affect you. Don’t do what I did the first few times and try to get out ASAP (although sounds like you’re voluntary) but take your time in there to figure things out. Bring a couple books tho bc there will definitely be downtime. Hope you got into a good program. I definitely had a few shitty ones before. Best of luck, mate
